SESSION MODE · セッション

Your 40 Minute Game Plan

One full Bochi meeting, start to finish. Work down the list together: each phase opens the right game, and when you finish a phase, mark it done and move on. At the end you get a summary with scores, new words, and homework for next time.

Conversation Rouletteかいわルーレット

Spin for a topic. Boru-san talks about it in Japanese, then Chihiro talks about it in English. Two minutes each, no pressure to be perfect. Finishing your talk earns +5 points.

Word Duelことばデュエル

A 12 turn head to head battle. On Boru-san's turns the word is Japanese and the answers are English. On Chihiro's turns it flips: English word, Japanese answers. Correct answers earn +10. Every word you get right joins your learned list on the summary.

TURN 1 OF 12
MATCH COMPLETE · たいけつ しゅうりょう

Translate Challengeほんやくチャレンジ

One player translates out loud, the other plays judge. Boru-san turns Japanese sentences into English. Chihiro turns English sentences into Japanese. Say it first, then reveal the model answer together. Judge taps Correct for +10.

Story Chainものがたりチェーン

Build a silly story together, one sentence at a time. Boru-san writes in Japanese (romaji is fine too), Chihiro writes in English. Each sentence earns +2. Use a twist word to make it weird. The sillier, the better.

VIDEO CALL · ビデオつうわ

Meet on Google Meet

Every booked session below includes its own Google Meet link in the Calendly confirmation, ready at your time. In a hurry? Start an instant Meet now and share the link with each other. When the call ends, save the recording in your shared library.

RECORDING · ろくが

Record your calls with Loom (free)

Google Meet's own recording is a paid feature, so BoChi pairs with Loom instead. Loom's Notetaker joins your Meet call, records the whole session, and saves it to your Loom library. The free plan records meetings of any length and holds up to 25 videos, plenty for your weekly sessions.

1

Create a free Loom account. Boru-san does this once, with the same Google account that holds the calendar.

2

Connect your Google Calendar in Loom and turn on meeting recording for meetings with a video link. Your Calendly sessions qualify automatically, because each booking carries its Meet link.

3

Admit the Loom Notetaker when it asks to join. It announces itself in the Meet chat, so Chihiro always knows the call is being recorded.

4

After the call, add the recording to BoChi. Copy its link from your Loom library and add it in Recordings: it lands in that day's meeting space, where both of you can watch it.

Shadow Battleシャドーバトル

A pronunciation duel. The app plays a phrase, then both of you repeat it out loud, shadowing the sound. The partner judges whose repetition nailed it. The round winner earns +10, and a round too close to call pays +5 each. Best of 5 rounds, and the loser owes a tongue twister on the next call.

SOLO SUMMARY · ひとりれんしゅうの まとめ

Writing Systemsもじ

Japanese runs on three scripts. Hiragana carries the native words and grammar, Katakana carries foreign words and names, and Kanji carries meaning. Tap any card to flip it over: the back shows the reading and a memory hook to hold it with. Mark the characters you have memorized and your percentages keep score.

YOUR PROGRESS · すすみぐあい

Overall: 0% ·

Hiraganaひらがな

The full Hiragana collection. Tap any card and it opens as one big card, like holding the real thing: flip it for the reading and the memory hook, then mark it once you know it. Your percentage sits at the top.

Katakanaカタカナ

The full Katakana collection, the script for foreign words, names, and emphasis. Tap any card to open it full page, flip it for the reading and the memory hook, and mark the ones you have memorized.

Kanjiかんじ

The Kanji collection, grouped by theme. Tap any card to open it full page: the back gives the reading, the meaning, and a memory hook built from the character's parts.
